about: Every place the mod touches a game's code: Harmony patches on VS's IL2CPP code (game vs, applied by MelonLoader from src/VsMod) and on ROUNDS's Assembly-CSharp (game rounds, applied by the engine from src/Engine). target must exist in that game's decompiled code; symbol must exist in src/.

rows.does: add the Vampire Rounds adventure (ADV_LIB_001), its stage set (STAGE_DATA_ADV_BMN002), its stage (a copy of the player's own Mad Forest data under the TEST slot) and the ROUNDS gun's weapon data (___PLCHLD200) to VS's data
point the adventure's roster and starting character at Orange's and Blue's runtime character types (VS gives custom characters their numbers at start)
register Orange and Blue through VS's own custom-character system, with their sprites and texts
build Orange's and Blue's character prefab from Antonio's (VS's workshop prefab builder)
the ROUNDS gun's VS weapon slot uses the Whip's prefab (it is taken away again before the run starts)
the Vampire Rounds adventure's card and menus use A Garlic Paradise's backdrop (VS has none for a new adventure and shows an empty white one)
the menus behind the Vampire Rounds adventure show VS's own main-menu art (another adventure's animated backdrop stays white outside its own adventure)
the Adventures button shows even without an adventure DLC, so everyone can reach Vampire Rounds
the Vampire Rounds card is always open (no DLC or Atlas needed)
Orange and Blue are both unlocked from the start of the Vampire Rounds adventure
no VS adventure merchant (it sells VS weapons) appears in the Vampire Rounds adventure
the same for merchants placed by a stage's tiles
no VS character merchant appears in the Vampire Rounds adventure either
no VS stage merchant (Pantalone sells VS weapons) in the Vampire Rounds adventure
take the ROUNDS gun's VS placeholder weapon away from Orange and Blue before the run starts (ROUNDS's real gun fires instead)
a level-up in a Vampire Rounds run opens ROUNDS's card pick instead of VS's level-up choice (VS's level and XP bookkeeping already ran)
a treasure chest in a Vampire Rounds run opens ROUNDS's card pick instead of VS's chest rewards
while ROUNDS's pick is open, VS's pause button does not open the pause menu (it would resume the game under the pick)
VS lands its enemies' hits on Orange or Blue its own way (its pacing); the health a hit takes is given back and sent to ROUNDS's health instead (blocked while ROUNDS's block is up)
while ROUNDS plays Orange or Blue, only ROUNDS's death ends their VS life
VS healing (Floor Chicken, regen) heals ROUNDS's health
in Melty's test run (no one playing) Orange walks a slow circle
ROUNDS's players read the VS player's input from the arena link
VS's camera and pits decide the edges, not ROUNDS's fixed arena box
VS decides when a fallen player comes back (co-op revive, retry)
record which card the player took on ROUNDS's pick screen
ROUNDS's pick screen follows the VS player's keys, stick or mouse
the hidden ROUNDS ignores the gamepad's Start: its escape menu would freeze ROUNDS and its buttons could quit or reload it mid-level
ROUNDS's QUIT GAME does nothing in the hidden engine (only VS closing ends it)
no extra ROUNDS players join from a gamepad or key press; only the arena makes players
ROUNDS's time stands still while VS is paused or away (ROUNDS's own pause: time scale 0)
no ROUNDS bullet hurts Orange or Blue, a partner's or their own (VS's weapons never hurt their owner; Bouncy bullets fly back across the screen)
co-op: no damage from a partner of any kind (explosions, card effects)
Poison and Parasite on a VS enemy: ROUNDS's DoT tick maths run on the VSTarget, each tick a HitDot with the poison colour and lifesteal per tick
records the running bullet (VSTarget.CurrentHit) so an enemy hit also gets the bullet's slow, knockback and ModdingUtils gravity
clears the running bullet even if RPCA_DoHit throws (a nested hit gets the outer bullet back)
one hit per bullet per VS enemy group per holdPlayerFor (ROUNDS's playersHit for enemies): drilling or piercing bullets cannot hit every frame
a bouncing bullet ends at a VS enemy as it does at a ROUNDS player (no bouncing off bosses, no Trickster gain from the boss)
a drilling bullet ends at a VS enemy as at a player instead of drilling through it like a wall (later effects such as poison still run)
bullet size and Ghost Bullets' ignoreWallsMask include enemy hit areas (layer 15); floors and walls stay out of ignoreWallsMask
starts this blast's bookkeeping so each VS enemy group takes the blast once, through its closest visible hit area
restores the previous blast context when Explode returns or throws

every Explosion card on VS enemies: slow, silence, Overpower (15% of the blocker's max HP), HitArea damage with dmgColor, Implosion pull, force with flyingFor and stun, using ROUNDS's scale flags, line of sight and immunity, once per enemy per blast; Orange's and Blue's blasts, their own or the partner's, only heal them (VS's horde stands on the player, so Explosive Bullet, Timed Detonation and Bombs Away would blow up their owner)
skipped on an object with no ParticleSystem (Healing field's circle: plain ROUNDS throws there)

the gun's masked sprites (Handle, Barrel) come on in gun black (tuning gunShade) with their masks off, after ROUNDS colours a gun: ROUNDS shows its gun as a soft shadow (SFPolygon), which our frame has no shadow pass for
safety net: no Overpower call with a null CharacterData or a missing spawner (the NRE that aborted the whole blast)
Dazzle stuns the VS enemy it is attached to (no NRE); on a wall it does nothing
one Dazzle per VS enemy (or per map piece) instead of one for the whole shared sandbox map
FollowPlayer{target=Other} (Chilling Presence and Lifestealer victim particles) sits on the enemy the aura chose, else the closest enemy, else is parked; no per-frame NRE and never on the partner
Thank You Sir, May I Have Another?: each VS hit that lands (Arena.VSHit) adds the card's max and current ammo, as a ROUNDS bullet hit would (applied only when PCE is installed)
Bouncy, Riccochet, Mayhem, Trickster, Target Bounce and Super Ball bullets bounce at the VS view's edges (ArenaViewCam), not at ROUNDS's menu camera 1000 units above the arena
Looper wraps bullets at the VS view's edges
ROUNDS's fixed screen box becomes the VS level view, just inside the level walls, so PCE Pac-Bullets and Pac-Player wrap there
Homing bullets curve toward the closest visible VS enemy, never toward the shooter or the partner
Target Bounce re-aims at the closest visible VS enemy after a bounce (0.1 s pause, aim line)
Radar Shot auto-fires attack-level shots at the closest visible VS enemy in range, never at the partner
Chase's +60% speed turns on when moving toward a visible VS enemy, not toward the partner
Saw's owner from the nearest SpawnedAttack, else the player it sits on (Abyssal Countdown's saw: an NRE in plain ROUNDS)
Saw and Abyssal Countdown saw the closest visible VS enemy (continuous damage plus both pushes); the partner is never shoved
Radiance rings hit and push the closest visible VS enemy once per ring, never the partner
Chilling Presence and Lifestealer auras fire on the closest visible VS enemy in range (ROUNDS: nobody solo, the partner in co-op)
Chilling Presence's additive slow lands on the aura's enemy
Lifestealer's drain hits the aura's enemy (the owner's heal stays native); Demonic Pact's self-cost is untouched
Shield Charge bumps each VS enemy once per charge: damage, knockback, recoil and the automatic block
co-op: charging into the partner no longer knocks them back
a thruster stuck to a light VS enemy lasts the full player time (bosses keep ROUNDS's x0.2)
a thruster pushes the VS enemy it sticks to on every physics step (continuous force)
ROUNDS's own Update runs; only its steering direction is replaced: Remote bullets steer toward the VS cursor, or the VS aim, instead of the hidden ROUNDS window's mouse

the hidden ROUNDS engine skips SteamAPI.Init (ROUNDS's manager stays, uninitialised, as after a failed Init), so Steam shows the player in VS only instead of switching between the two games; ROUNDS started normally is untouched
remember where a Teleport starts
Teleport never lands outside the level (past VS's bound walls or ceiling); ROUNDS's 10 steps are re-run inside the level view
seen from above nothing falls: arena bullets fly straight (gravity off)
count each seat's shots (logs and the gun-fired test check)
